why: The owner on /scenarios/expr-n35: 'kind of nice idea but horrible rendering, looks poorly designed, but good component maybe.' n35 is a per-day track of intervals and events, built from hand-drawn divs because its builder found no kit form for it (apps/playground/src/scenarios/expr/n35/ExprN35.tsx: DayRow :221, Mark :72, EventMark :283; its comments say the kit has no interval track). The hand build shows why it looks poor: fixed column widths (`w-12` :176 and :245, `w-10` :184 and :278), titles hidden below a hand breakpoint (WIDE_LABELS = 900, :59), raw colour utilities per kind (:14-17), an accent outline (:259) and lint waivers (:20 and others). `primitive-bypass` exists to stop this and was waived. The kit does ship seam tracks (packages/basalt-ui/src/charts/track.ts, seams/, apps/playground/src/recipes/seam-track.tsx), so first establish whether a track of intervals is a gap or a discoverability failure.
what: packages/basalt-ui/src/charts (a kind over the existing host, or the seam track made reachable), its contract lines, docs, skill routing and one playground demo.
owns: packages/basalt-ui/src/charts/** (the new kind and its contract lines)
change: Spec first. State what n35 needed (rows by day or by entity, intervals with start and end, point events, a shared time axis, a focus that links to a list) and whether seam tracks already cover it. If they do, the work is the missing props, a kind name a builder finds, and skill routing. If not, ship one kind that composes CartesianChart like every other kind: band rows, interval marks and point marks on a time x axis, labels placed by the kit's label engine (fit, truncate, drop by priority, never a hand breakpoint), colours from registered series only, the shared focus contract, phone form at 390, loading, empty and error states. Check the idea against two more cases from docs/v3/expression/cases.md before fixing the API, so the kind is not shaped by one page. The Spec carries shots of the kind drawing n35's data beside n35 as built.
acceptance: A Spec that states gap or discoverability, with shots, has a verdict before code merges
n35's data renders through the shipped kind with no hand-drawn mark, no fixed width class and no waiver (a playground demo route, not an edit to the scenario)
Labels fit or drop by the label engine at 390 and 1800 (layout test)
Focus links the track to a list through the existing focus contract (test)
The kind is in the generated docs and the basalt-charts skill's kind table
Budget and contract changes are recorded; make check passes
out_of_scope: A Gantt with dependencies; drag to edit; the dependency graph (v3-owner-1-chain-view).
proof: make check; shots at 1800 and 390, light and dark.
commits: feat: the kind with tests (package); feat: the playground demo.
note: Source: the owner's first hands-on review of the v3 playground on 2026-11-18. He asked for the root cause to be fixed, not the page he named. File citations come from a code read on that date at master 7c454b3a0 and were not run in a browser: confirm each before building on it.
